verdict.rationale: Context-window management is a fair axis for an agent framework, but the evidence pack never documents trimming, summarizing, or filtering conversation history to fit a model's context window. The unified Memory class with composite-scored recall is a related retrieval feature, not conversation-history compaction, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trim, summarize, or filter conversation history to keep an agent inside its context window
